description: This Dart source file provides classes and functions for handling local storage, including token management via shared preferences, and an offline queue for attendance data backed by sqflite database. It contains storage keys, a TokenStorage class for JWT/session tokens, a QueuedAttendance model class, and an AttendanceQueue class for managing queued attendance items including database initialization and CRUD operations.

classes.name: TokenStorage
classes.description: A utility class for storing, retrieving, and clearing an authentication token using shared preferences.

classes.name: QueuedAttendance
classes.description: A model class representing a queued attendance item with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities for database storage.

classes.name: AttendanceQueue
classes.description: A class providing an offline queue backed by sqflite for handling attendance data, including initialization and queue management methods.

methods.name: TokenStorage.getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored JWT or session token from shared preferences.

methods.name: TokenStorage.setToken
methods.description: Stores a JWT or session token into shared preferences.

methods.name: TokenStorage.clearToken
methods.description: Removes the stored token from shared preferences.

methods.name: QueuedAttendance.toRow
methods.description: Converts a QueuedAttendance instance to a map suitable for database insertion.

methods.name: QueuedAttendance.fromRow
methods.description: Creates a QueuedAttendance instance from a database row.

methods.name: AttendanceQueue.open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the database connection, returning a singleton AttendanceQueue instance.

methods.name: AttendanceQueue.enqueue
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a QueuedAttendance item into the queue database.

methods.name: AttendanceQueue.dequeue
methods.description: Removes an item from the queue by its ID.

methods.name: AttendanceQueue.listAll
methods.description: Lists all queued attendance items ordered by creation time.

methods.name: AttendanceQueue.drain
methods.description: Processes all queued items in FIFO order with a handler; removes items once processed.
